summary_en: MOR-PAM combines an eight-focus diffractive optical element with a custom acoustic mask that assigns distinguishable temporal responses to photoacoustic signals from different focal spots. A single-element detector can therefore recover the multiplexed measurements, yielding an eightfold speed increase over conventional point-scanned OR-PAM at the same laser repetition rate.

summary_en: The paper introduces 2D-AE-PAM, in which a diffractive optical element generates a two-dimensional focal array and a compact acoustic mask encodes each focal position into a distinct temporal response. Model-based decoding recovers the multiplexed measurements from one planar transducer, providing fourfold faster optical-resolution photoacoustic imaging while maintaining 3.3 micrometer lateral resolution.
